lead: Hard-edged aviation film still, stormy slate sky, flashes of yellow light.
notes: Mood-only mini images for thunderstrike-justice.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen thunderstrike-justice-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish thunderstrike-justice-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: squadron
images.prompt: A hidden airstrip in a mountain valley at dawn, a few fighter jets under camouflage nets.

images.name: regime
images.prompt: A grim walled compound behind barbed wire, searchlights sweeping across it at night.

images.name: target
images.prompt: An empty ornate office with a heavy desk and tall dark windows, a cold portrait light.

images.name: battle
images.prompt: A fighter jet flying low over the sea toward a rocky island with smoke rising from it.

images.name: campaign
images.prompt: A long line of runway lights stretching into the distance at dusk.

images.name: win-log
images.prompt: A pilot's flight log open on a desk beside a helmet, a storm outside the window.

images.name: break
images.prompt: A fighter jet parked in a hangar after rain, its canopy open.

images.name: flight
images.prompt: A fighter jet in a wide banking turn, vapor trails streaming from its wingtips.

images.name: lock-on
images.prompt: A cockpit view through the canopy at a distant enemy jet in the clouds.

images.name: fallers
images.prompt: A burning aircraft trailing black smoke as it falls toward the sea.
